3.name: Blessings of Knowledge
3.notes: You gain proficiency with one type of Artisan's Tools of your choice. You also gain proficiency in two skills of your choice from Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion, and you have Expertise in those two skills.

3.name: Knowledge Domain Spells
3.notes: You always have the following spells prepared, see @domain_spells table

3.name: Mind Magic
3.notes: As a Magic action, you can expend one use of Channel Divinity to cast a prepared Divination spell from the Knowledge Domain Spells table. You cast the spell without expending a spell slot or requiring Material components.

6.name: Unfettered Mind
6.notes:
You gain telepathy out to 60 feet and can simultaneously communicate with a number of creatures equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).

You gain proficiency in Intelligence saving throws. If you already have it, you instead gain proficiency in another saving throw of your choice for which you lack proficiency.

17.name: Divine Foreknowledge
17.notes:
As a Bonus Action, you expand your mind toward the future. For 1 hour, you have Advantage on all D20 Tests.

Once used, this feature can’t be used again until after a Long Rest, unless you expend a level 6+ spell slot to restore its use.
